notes.title: "Pretty Girls Rivers" Dressing room powered up!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41521549/29827913c37edc954b05134752267dae24397a3a.jpg[/img]

The dressing room is a familiar feature of the "Pretty Girls" series, with greatly increased functions!
When you complete each stage, you will get a new costume for your character, which will be added to your dressing room.
The "Pretty Girls Rivers" dressing room has been expanded to allow up to 6 characters to be placed in the room at the same time!
You can also customize the position of each character, their facial expressions and their costumes!
[list]
[*]Riche
Feared as a demon king, but despite her title, she is actually a quiet and kind-hearted demon girl.
[*]Reiu
She has a strong sense of duty and is kind to those under her. She is serious and earnest in everything she does.
[*]Kanon
An idol among idols, popular for her smile and cheerful manner of speaking and gestures.
[*]Ren
She is cool and hates to lose. She has a bit of a temper, but faces everything head-on.
[*]Cecil
Her good looks and shyness give others the impression that she's a bit of a jerk, but inside she's kind and motherly.
[*]Risa
With her cool good looks and strong personality, she is adored by the girls around her and admired by the boys as well.
[/list]
We'll keep you posted on all things gaming from our community!
Don't forget to add "Pretty Girls Rivers" to your Wishlist and follow us so you don't miss out on the latest news.
Please look forward to the release!
